name: SVC_BI_QUEUE_RESOURCES
description: This table is used for BI to store the resources (individual and teams) that belong to queues.

columns.name: BI_QUEUE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: QUEUE_RS_TEAM_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the queue resource relationship flattened structure and alternate key for this table.

columns.name: QUEUE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Indicates Queue Resource ID and references SVC_QUEUE_RESOURCES(QUEUE_RESOURCE_ID).

columns.name: QUEUE_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Queue ID. Loaded from SVC_QUEUE_RESOURCES.QUEUE_ID and references SVC_QUEUES (QUEUE_ID).

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Loaded from SVC_QUEUE_RESOURCES.OBJECT_ID and references either HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID) for the resource ID or JTF_RS_TEAMS (TEAM_ID) for the resource team ID.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Loaded from SVC_QUEUE_RESOURCES.OBJECT_TYPE_CD. Indicates type of resource - 'ORA_SVC_RESOURCE' or 'ORA_SVC_RESOURCE_TEAM'.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Loaded from SVC_QUEUE_RESOURCES.ENABLED_FLAG. Indicates whether the resource is enabled (Y or N) for the queue.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Loaded from SVC_QUEUE_RESOURCES.DELETED_FLAG. Indicates whether this queue resource record is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Indicates the consolidated Resource ID. In case the resource type is 'ORA_SVC_RESOURCE_TEAM', then the Resource ID is Team Resource ID from JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS, otherwise Resource ID is Object ID from SVC_QUEUE_RESOURCES.

columns.name: UNIQUE_RESOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a resource is assigned one time or multiple times to a specific queue (Y or N). An individual can be assigned one time to a specific queue. But, the same individual could belong to multiple teams and those teams can be assigned to the same queue.

columns.name: RS_TEAM_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Resource Team Member ID. It is loaded from JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS.TEAM_MEMBER_ID.

columns.name: RS_TEAM_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Resource Team ID. It is loaded from JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS.TEAM_ID.

columns.name: RS_TEAM_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Team Resource ID. It is loaded from JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS.TEAM_RESOURCE_ID.

columns.name: RS_RESOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of the resource - 'INDIVIDUAL' or 'GROUP'. Loaded from JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS.RESOURCE_TYPE.

columns.name: RS_CREATED_BY
columns.description: Indicates the user who created the row of JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS if RS_TEAM_MEMBER_ID is not null.

columns.name: RS_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the creation of JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS row if RS_TEAM_MEMBER_ID is not null.

columns.name: RS_LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Indicates the user who last updated the row of JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS if RS_TEAM_MEMBER_ID is not null.

columns.name: RS_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the last update of JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS row if RS_TEAM_MEMBER_ID is not null.

columns.name: RS_LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row of JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS if RS_TEAM_MEMBER_ID is not null.

columns.name: RS_DELETE_FLAG
columns.description: Loaded from JTF_RS_TEAM_MEMBERS.DELETE_FLAG. Indicates whether the resource record is logically deleted (Y or N). It makes sense only if RS_TEAM_MEMBER_ID is not null.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Loaded from SVC_QUEUE_RESOURCES.PRIORITY. Indicates the priority of an overflow queue.

columns.name: BI_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: The date and time this record was created.

columns.name: BI_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: The date and time this record was last updated.

columns.name: BI_DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this row is logically deleted (Y or N).
